method: Built-in imagegen image editing (not API mode), one edit per source photograph.
style: Previously approved gentle realistic color instant-film, borderless and without text; preserve red crests and species-specific plumage.
numbering: 07–13 follow the order of the seven user attachments, continuing from the previous six images.
note: Generative image editing preserves the overall scene but may change fine details; this is not a pixel-identical conventional color filter. Originals were not overwritten.

images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, realistic wildlife photo grading with strict scene preservation. IMAGE 1 is the ONLY edit target. IMAGE 2 is solely the previously approved gentle instant-color film rendering reference: borrow the restrained photographic tonal response and fine grain only, NEVER borrow its animal, fur, water, background, composition or blue palette. Deliver ONE full-bleed photograph with image 1's original complete framing and aspect ratio. No paper, white border, frame, text, labels, collage or UI. Preserve the entire original scene, camera viewpoint, bird size and placement, precise pose and anatomy, number of wings and feet, beak shape, eye and iris color, crest shape, all black/white/red plumage markings, feather distribution, motion blur, optical softness, background depth of field, trees, occlusions and lighting. This is a subtle color-and-texture treatment, NOT a redraw or sharpen/reconstruction request. Do not invent anatomy, remove vegetation, alter feather patterns, enlarge the bird, crop, straighten, recompose, replace background or synthesize extra plumage detail. Match approved mild realistic instant-film style: gently rich tonal contrast, deep but legible shadows, very subtle cool-neutral shadows, soft creamy highlights without yellow staining, delicate organic stable fine grain, restrained photographic softness, subtle broad corner falloff. Natural forest greens can be a little softer and less electric with nuanced olive tones, bark neutrals a little warm. Species coloration is essential: keep the striking red crest naturally saturated scarlet, not orange/magenta, do not desaturate it; black plumage stays near-neutral charcoal with readable feather layering, not flattened silhouette, purple or brown; white plumage stays clear off-white with soft highlight transitions and retained texture. Preserve original local light and focus, including honest motion blur. No scratches, dust, light leaks, heavy vintage brown wash, cyan cast, strong vignette, illustration, painting, sketch, artificial HDR/detail, oversharpening, bloom or added haze. Output high-resolution photographic edit.
